tce-pr.headline: From UX research to shipped front-end inside public governance software
tce-pr.story: I joined the software engineering team at the Court of Accounts of Paraná to work across the full product loop — user research, prototyping, system modeling, and front-end implementation. It is where design decisions meet audit and governance constraints, and where I learn what it means to ship inside a public institution.
tce-pr.teaser: From UX research and prototyping to front-end implementation inside a public audit institution — where design decisions meet governance constraints.

furia.headline: Two years localizing esports at film scale for Brazil's biggest gaming brand
furia.story: Over two years I translated scripts, subtitles, films, and sponsor decks for FURIA — from Nike and Santander to PokerStars. The work sat between advertising and broadcast: tight deadlines, brand voice, and international negotiations that had to land perfectly in Portuguese.
furia.teaser: Two years translating scripts, subtitles, and sponsor decks for one of Brazil's biggest esports brands — Nike, Santander, PokerStars, and production at film scale.

freelang-teacher.headline: A decade teaching adults English and German — the root of Milebrick
freelang-teacher.story: Since 2015 I have taught English and German privately to adults at every level. It is the long experiment in how people actually acquire language — what motivates them, what bores them, and what a product like Milebrick would need to respect.
freelang-teacher.teaser: Teaching English and German to adults since 2015 — the long experiment in how people actually acquire language, which later feeds Milebrick.

bpartners.headline: Translating sponsor decks for a Jonas Brothers São Paulo campaign
bpartners.story: A short PJ contract translating presentations and documents for live negotiations — including the Jonas Brothers show in São Paulo, executed with agency BFerraz. High stakes, fast turnaround, zero room for tone mistakes.
bpartners.teaser: Short contract translating negotiation decks — including the Jonas Brothers São Paulo show campaign produced with BFerraz.

esfer-spfw.headline: Producing the runway theme for São Paulo Fashion Week
esfer-spfw.story: I composed and produced the runway theme for SPFW — fashion tempo, a different kind of client sign-off, and the pressure of a single moment when the collection walks. I also scored other audiovisual pieces, including a FURIA jersey launch teaser.
esfer-spfw.teaser: Composed and produced the runway theme for SPFW — fashion tempo, deadline pressure, and a different kind of client sign-off.

cei-flora.headline: Editorial design for classroom materials at scale
cei-flora.story: At one of Goiânia's largest English schools for children, I supported teachers with didactic materials, classroom graphics, and book editorial — design in service of educators, not just the brand on the cover.
cei-flora.teaser: Editorial graphics and classroom materials for one of Goiânia's largest English schools for children — design in service of teachers, not just the brand.

skill-idiomas.headline: Group classes in English and German for teens and adults
skill-idiomas.story: I taught English and German in group settings for teenagers and adults — early training in reading a room, adapting explanation on the fly, and keeping a whole class moving together.
skill-idiomas.teaser: English and German in group classes for teens and adults — early training in reading a room and adapting explanation on the fly.

wizard.headline: First franchise teaching rhythm — English in groups, German one-to-one
wizard.story: Wizard was my first stable income from teaching: English in groups for teens and adults, German in individual lessons. The franchise rhythm taught me structure, pacing, and how to repeat a method without sounding robotic.
wizard.teaser: Franchise classroom rhythm: group English, one-to-one German, and the first stable income from teaching.

salto-publicidade.headline: Advertising studio work and mentoring designers on Adobe workflows
salto-publicidade.story: At Salto Publicidade I built campaign assets and brand identities in Photoshop and Illustrator — and trained new designers on the studio's Adobe workflows. My first agency environment with real client pressure.
salto-publicidade.teaser: Advertising studio work in Photoshop and Illustrator — brand identity, campaign assets, and mentoring new designers on Adobe workflows.

cicopal.headline: In-house packaging and retail campaigns for a food-industry group
cicopal.story: Cicopal's internal agency served multiple food brands across Brazil's center-west. I designed packaging and retail campaigns where consistency across product lines mattered as much as any single hero visual.
cicopal.teaser: In-house agency for a food-industry group — multi-brand packaging and retail campaigns across Brazil's center-west.

au-pair-germany.headline: Ten months of German immersion in Bavaria
au-pair-germany.story: I spent ten months as an au-pair in Haag, Bavaria — living with a host family while studying German. Cultural friction, daily conversation, and the decision to keep German in my professional life afterward.
au-pair-germany.teaser: Ten months in Haag, Germany — language immersion, cultural friction, and the decision to keep German in my life professionally.

deviante-suporte-decisao-manutencao.title: Sistema de suporte à decisão para manutenção industrial
deviante-suporte-decisao-manutencao.excerpt: Desenvolvimento de um sistema web que combina IPDD, ADWIN, aprendizado de máquina e avaliação humana para detectar desvios e apoiar a manutenção baseada em condição.
body: O trabalho narra o desenvolvimento de um sistema de suporte à decisão em gestão de manutenção industrial. O produto de software origina-se do estudo e implantação do IPDD, um framework que recebe dados de máquinas e detecta pontos próximos ao início da degradação através de previsões facilitadas por aprendizado de máquina, permitindo a gestores direcionar anomalias para ações corretivas de inspeção e manutenção baseada em condição. A identificação estatística das mudanças cabe ao algoritmo de janelamento adaptativo ADWIN, que compara registros antigos e recentes em janelas ajustadas dinamicamente, sinalizando desvio quando a diferença entre elas ultrapassa um limiar estatístico definido por um parâmetro de sensibilidade configurável através de componentes da interface. Análises são geradas tanto sobre o tempo de permanência nos eventos quanto a parâmetros de condição do maquinário. Porém, as anomalias detectadas ainda exigem o ponderamento do gestor para a tomada de decisão. A detecção automatizada integrada à avaliação humana atende a princípios de centralidade humana previstos na Indústria 5.0. Partimos de uma lacuna encontrada na literatura: a ausência de estrutura hierárquica entre objetos e atributos do domínio de manutenção gera sobrecarga cognitiva para a interpretação. Foi aplicado o processo ORCA, da metodologia de OOUX, para estruturar objetos de valor do ecossistema de manutenção. O processo resultou em seis objetos de domínio que, aliados a oito casos de uso, compuseram a usabilidade da interface em ambiente web, desde o carregamento de dados até a execução de análises de desvio e o agendamento de ações proativas. O trabalho visa contribuir com a interação de parâmetros que devem ser analisados e ajustados dinamicamente, convergindo na interface o diagnóstico do equipamento, informações do processo e falhas detectadas. A estruturação semântica do domínio, aliada a requisitos funcionais especificado no caso de uso, foi o que viabilizou a implantação do sistema por meio de desenvolvimento em linguagem natural, otimizado por um repositório de componentes reutilizáveis de IA. Testes iniciais identificaram desvios em dados sintéticos e apresentaram bons resultados.
Palavras-chave: 1. Mineração de Processo; 2. Manutenção baseada em condição; 3. Experiência Orientada a Objetos; 4. Sistema de Suporte a Decisão.
